name: eth-name-refused
description: Bob tries to chat as a guest named vitalik.eth, then with look-alikes of it, a Cyrillic e and a full-width dot, and each must be refused with the reason shown, since a name ending in .eth is kept for verified ENS names. A plain name is then taken, and his message shows it with the guest badge.
steps: bob send "a guest, not an ENS name {run}"
expect sender bob "a guest, not an ENS name {run}" name=chosen:bob badge=guest stamp=gateway
